import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 10 Products by Revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().reset_index()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment['customer_age_group'] = pd.Categorical(age_payment['customer_age_group'], 
                                                     categories=age_order, ordered=True)
age_payment = age_payment.sort_values('customer_age_group')
pivot_data = age_payment.pivot(index='customer_age_group', columns='payment_method', values='total')
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], color=['#D4A574', '#6F4E37', '#C8A882'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Takeaway vs Dine-in by Size
takeaway_size = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['quantity'].sum().reset_index()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
takeaway_size['size'] = pd.Categorical(takeaway_size['size'], categories=size_order, ordered=True)
takeaway_size = takeaway_size.sort_values('size')
takeaway_size['order_type'] = takeaway_size['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
pivot_takeaway = takeaway_size.pivot(index='size', columns='order_type', values='quantity')
pivot_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E'], width=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Items Sold', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Orders by Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Order Type', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Hour
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
hourly_avg = df.groupby('hour')['total'].mean().reset_index()
axes[1, 1].plot(hourly_avg['hour'], hourly_avg['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
                markersize=6, color='#8B4513')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(hourly_avg['hour'], hourly_avg['total'], alpha=0.3, color='#D2691E')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value Throughout the Day', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
